behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert multihop/reverse round-trip, disconnected/unknown distinctions and snapshot/frozen inputs.
Assert consistent rational duplicates, inconsistent cycles in any component and input/value errors.
docDelivery: Document edge direction/reversal and exact consistency checks.
Explain converter numeric tolerance, snapshot and unknown/disconnected/error behavior.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Bounded multiplicative rational unit graph, exact consistency and stable numeric conversions across connected paths.
manualBehavior: Factory delegates to graph core; exact rational consistency cannot be replaced by floating epsilon checks.
independence: Refactor direct conversions into reusable conversion graph preserving supported values and rejecting inconsistent paths.
